entry_gate: G9 FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_AUDIT ok and acceptance snapshot saved
question: On genuinely new voices, does using a frozen spatial adapter as a standard MVDR mask source change the fixed-versus-rotated direction tradeoff compared with its direct waveform output?
selection_notice: Narrowing to no-clean-identity branch follows viewed G5-G9 evidence; fresh voices test this narrowed hypothesis. No claim that the excluded identity branch is universally worse.
source_selection: First4 fully eligible unseen speakers in archive order,4 complete1-3.8s mono16k FLACs each with full official transcripts. Exclude all G1/G2/G3/G5 speaker IDs,source IDs and source-file SHA. No ASR/quality selection and no fallback.
noise_notice: Reuse four existing recordings; fresh speakers,not unseen noise recordings or real rooms. No new noise download.
simulator: Same nominal six-mic free-field,FIR guard64,HPF40 before active-SNR,whole-scene rotation,shared clips/common scale per3-target group; assert identical noisy ref mic4 and clean reference across target angles.
direct_systems: Noisy,originalMcNet,all3 G5 seeds each fixed/rotated without_clean_identity:8 systems.
MVDR_systems: OriginalMcNet estimate and each of6 adapter estimates -> same frozen G9 mask_mvdr implementation/settings:7 systems. No oracle in primary G10.
primary_analysis: Direct-to-MVDR change for originalMcNet and each geometry/all3 seeds, separately by target/noise; interaction of output mode and fixed/rotated training. No best-seed selection. All SI-SDR/PESQ/STOI and both original fixed ASR backends.
uncertainty: Four independent speakers,four utterances each; descriptive per-speaker effects plus2000 speaker-cluster bootstrap,fixed seed20261112. Repeated conditions/seed rows do not increase independent sample count; no multiplicity-controlled significance claim.
clean_controls: New full48 clean conditions for all15 systems, same sources and target-angle groups. ASR reference baseline is not a guaranteed mathematical WER lower bound.
stage_gates: Source report/snapshot -> data+systems report/snapshot -> direct signals report -> MVDR signals report -> Whisper report -> CTC+joint total report/audit. Preserve failures and snapshots,never overwrite old projects.
